title: Kontext safety checks stop waiting indefinitely
summary:
Image requests shed telemetry wait time and stalled safety checks, while interim queue and cache limits were rolled back.

Azure Flux Kontext prompt and input-image safety checks now time out after 30 seconds if they stall. Requests get a timeout error instead of occupying a queue slot indefinitely.

Image requests no longer wait for telemetry to finish before responding. Cache hits also skip an external-provider lookup and record `cloudflare-cache` as the source that served the image.

The image registry now lists flux, kontext, turbo, and gptimage, with corrected provider metadata for the first three. An interim one-slot anonymous queue limit was reverted, so anonymous and registered requests can each use up to five slots. The cache limit was raised to 500,000 entries, replacing the day's earlier 20,000-entry eviction rule.
